biotools.summary: spoQC is a modular framework for multimodal quality control (QC) of imaging-based spatially resolved transcriptomics (SRT). It independently evaluates cell segmentation, imaging, and transcript data to identify high-quality regions (HQRs) across entire tissue sections. In addition, spoQC uses Markov random fields (MRFs) to incorporate spatial dependencies and generate spatially refined QC masks.
biotools.name: spoQC
